{{Quote|Well this is perfume compared to the rest of the docks|Mira, to the Jedi Exile|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Flophouse''' was a slum located in the [[Nar Shaddaa Docks|docks]] owned by [[Vogga]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] operating on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Residents==
The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], in her search for [[Zez-Kai Ell]], interacted with or helped many flophouse residents.
{{GameLS|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}

====Vogga Thugs====
In one room, the Exile found two [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] plotting to get into [[Vogga]]'s stash. She used their tactics and got in.

====Mandalorians====
In another room, she found some [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore]] convinced them to go to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].

====Lunar Shadow Crewmen====
In another room, she found some Lunar Shadow Crewmen and got them a captain.

====Bith scientist====
In another room, she found a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], who asked her to pick up an item from a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. She found the Twi'lek dead, was attacked by a cleaning [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and when she returned to the flophouse, the Bith was dead; killed by his own droid.

====Lasavvou====
In the next room, she found an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] named [[Lasavvou]] who needed to pay off a fee. She got Lasavvou allowed to leave.

====Lootra====
In the next room, she found a refugee named [[Lootra]]. She had him reunited with his wife.

==The large room==
The large room belonged to [[Mira]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. She brought the Exile there on her way to see [[Visquis]] in the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]], drugged her, took her Space Suit, and left. The exile later met [[Zez-Kai Ell]] in there.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nar Shaddaa Flophouse appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', developed by [[Obsidian Entertainment]]. Several quests involving the residents are available to the player. If the player chooses the dark-side options, they can kill the crewman, Lasavvou, and Lootra. They will also fight [[Zez-Kai Ell]] in the large room.
